featured.title: Meet with Dr. Reza Moridi
featured.description: Our students sat down with Dr. Reza Moridi, former Ontario Minister of Research, Innovation and Science, for an exclusive interview on the future of AI and its impact on the next generation. He shared his vision for how young people can prepare for an AI-driven world and why programs like Ithaca are essential.
